title: AI Grid: Gateways
description: Envoy data plane of every gateway (MaaS gateway on the ingress sites, serving gateway everywhere): downstream, upstream, filters (ext_proc, wasm shim, rate-limit and auth services), Istio request families, resources.

panels.title: Requests/s by gateway and connection manager
Request time p50 / p95 / p99 by gateway

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (cluster, gateway_name, le) (rate(envoy_http_downstream_rq_time_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", gateway_name=~"$gateway"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, gateway_name, le) (rate(envoy_http_downstream_rq_time_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", gateway_name=~"$gateway"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, gateway_name, le) (rate(envoy_http_downstream_rq_time_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", gateway_name=~"$gateway"}[5m])))

panels.title: Responses/s by class (Istio, gateway as source)

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, source_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", reporter="source", namespace="openshift-ingress", response_code=~"2.."}[5m]))
sum by (cluster, source_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", reporter="source", namespace="openshift-ingress", response_code=~"4.."}[5m]))
sum by (cluster, source_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", reporter="source", namespace="openshift-ingress", response_code=~"5.."}[5m]))

panels.title: Listener connection overflows/s and requests active
Upstream (clusters: model backends, EPP, Authorino, Limitador)
Upstream request time p95 by upstream cluster (top 12)

targets.expr: topk(12, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, cluster_name, le) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", gateway_name=~"$gateway"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Upstream requests completed/s by upstream cluster (top 12)
Rate-limit service latency p95 (gateway view; the auth service is a gRPC stream without request timing)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, gateway_name, le) (rate(envoy_cluster_kuadrant_ratelimit_service_upstream_rq_time_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", gateway_name=~"$gateway"}[5m])))

panels.title: Filters: external processing (EPP), wasm shim, overload
wasm shim VM reloads (success, failure) and ext_proc failure-mode allowed/s
Requests/s by gateway workload and response code

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, source_workload, response_code) (rate(istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", reporter="source", namespace="openshift-ingress"}[5m]))

panels.title: Request duration p95 by gateway workload

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, source_workload, le) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", reporter="source", namespace="openshift-ingress"}[5m])))

panels.title: Request and response bytes/s by gateway workload
istio-proxy memory working set per gateway pod
CPU throttled seconds/s per gateway pod
